title: InformationExchange
description: TOGAF-sourced interaction archetype — data flow between components. An information exchange represents the coupling between an Effector (producer) and a Receptor (consumer) through which data is communicated. Extends Interaction with TOGAF Application/Data Architecture vocabulary. Source framework: TOGAF (Content Metamodel → Information System Service / Data Flow).

exchangePattern.description: Communication pattern. SYNC_REQUEST_REPLY = blocking call/response, ASYNC_FIRE_AND_FORGET = one-way message, ASYNC_PUBLISH_SUBSCRIBE = topic-based fan-out, BATCH_TRANSFER = scheduled bulk exchange. TOGAF mapping: Information Exchange pattern.

protocol.description: Transport protocol. Governs interoperability constraints and technology selection.

dataFormat.description: Payload serialization format. Governs schema registry requirements and compatibility rules.
